title: Monotonicity in the time bound
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $L$ be a language of binary strings, and let $T_1,T_2\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $T_1(m)\le T_2(m)$ for every $m$. If $N$ halts within $T_1(|x|)$ steps on every branch and outputs the membership indicator for $L$ with probability at least $2/3$ on every input $x$, then it also has these properties with time bound $T_2$.
